]

    {"date": "2026-10-25", "from": "sam-rivera", "amount": 60.00, "note": "groceries", "type": "income"},
    {"date": "2026-10-29", "from": "morgan-chen", "to": "nymaids00", "amount": 180.00, "note": "October cleaning", "type": "send"},
]

for t in venmo_transactions:

    if Q3_START <= date_str <= Q3_END:

        seen_venmo.add(key)
        unique_venmo.append(t)

print(f"  Found {len(q3_bank)} transactions in Q3")

# Consolidate and save the file
